For each enumerated payment key, copy only its expressly stated payment medium. Phrases such as ‘paid … in hay’ state hay as a noncash medium and must not become null. A dollar amount does not imply cash, and absence of the word cash does not imply absence of a medium. If no medium is stated, or its attachment to a particular payment is ambiguous, return this relation unread rather than emitting null.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
